items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I’ve worked, well I worked in Chicago New Years with Clark, and I’ve been working with him on and off for you know like whenever we can get a gig together.

ctx.x: Clark Terry is being brought to our college in May to receive an honorary doctorate.

Oh, that’s great. That’s great. Let me tell you. I’ve worked, well I worked in Chicago New Years with Clark, and I’ve been working with him on and off for you know like whenever we can get a gig together. And this man is really a giver. He’s not a taker. He’s got this jazz institute in Iowa, the Clark Terry Jazz Institute, it’s a techy old university, in LeMars, Iowa, and I’ve taught a few classes there. In fact I’m supposed to go there in June. But I like, I do whatever I can for him. You know I’ll refuse a gig…

That’s great. We want to thank Red Holloway for sharing all these great thoughts with us, and, you said some things today that I think ought to be written down and recited to some of our — some great, great quotes.
